predictions: 7/8 fire; hyphens in prose and plain numbers stay quiet
notes: Card: '-' x17, '_of' x2, '_month', '_Enter', '_ex'. Top '-' examples are ISBNs; '_' pieces in identifiers are not claimed (probes 0.02-0.05). Probe: 'ISBN 0-88192' 0.54; 'well-known press' 0.01.
